title: Quitting while audioWorklet.addModule() is pending hangs Web shutdown
body:
### Tested versions

4.7.1 a13da4feb8d8aefc283c3763d33a2f170a18d541
4.7.2
4.8 dev 7
master e7cfa294a0b81bed7986be04a848cc1832a3f083 



### System information

cachyos 7950x3d 9070xt emscripten web build firefox

### Issue description

Quitting while audioWorklet.addModule() is pending can leave Web shutdown unfinished which can also happen due to system load. GodotAudio.close_async() clears GodotAudio.ctx before calling its driver's asynchronous close(). The worklet creation callback then uses the null context to construct AudioWorkletNode. Both start variants also need the context destination. Firefox reports a TypeError and onExit never runs.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Import the supplied project into Godot 4. (archive.zip)
2. Export with the standard Web HTML shell to a new folder as index.html. Select your built patched or unpatched release template. Test Thread Support enabled and disabled separately.
3. Run:  `python3 web_audio_shutdown_browser.py --export /path/to/export --output /tmp/shutdown-new --expect-race` the same command can be used to verify the patch fixes (just delete output dir and remove  --expect-race). put the .js file beside the .py runner script

(python 3.12)

it modifies the HTML to test, holds mixing-worklet module initialization until 250 ms after WEB_AUDIO_QUIT
